name: AI Job Search: Resume → Scored Job Matches

options.system: You are a precise resume-parsing engine for a recruitment automation system. Always respond with a single valid JSON object matching the requested schema and nothing else.

parameters.command: ={{ $env.PYTHON_CMD || 'python' }} -c "import sqlite3, json, os; db = os.path.join(os.environ.get('DATA_DIR', '/data'), 'Database/jobs.db'); conn=sqlite3.connect(db); c=conn.cursor(); c.execute('SELECT job_url FROM jobs'); urls=[r[0] for r in c.fetchall()]; conn.close(); print(json.dumps(urls))"

parameters.text: [Job Automation] No new jobs found in today's search.

values.content:
=Candidate Skills: {{ $('Parse Candidate Profile').first().json.skills.join(', ') }}
Candidate Experience: {{ $('Parse Candidate Profile').first().json.yearsExperience }} years
Candidate Summary: {{ $('Parse Candidate Profile').first().json.summary }}

Job Title: {{ $json.title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Job Location: {{ $json.jobLocation }}
Job Description: {{ $json.description }}

Evaluate the fit of the candidate for this job using the following weighted rubric:
1. Skills Overlap (40%): Fit between candidate skills and job requirements.
2. Experience Match (20%): Fit between candidate years of experience and job needs.
3. Location/Remote Fit (20%): Remote alignment and location preferences.
4. Role Fit (20%): Title alignment.

Calculate a final score (0-100) using this rubric. Identify the skill gap (skills in job but missing in resume) and contact email if mentioned.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object matching this schema:
{
  "matchScore": number,
  "matchedSkills": "string list of matching skills",
  "skillGap": "string list of missing skills",
  "experienceMatch": "High / Medium / Low",
  "locationMatch": "Yes / No",
  "remoteMatch": "Yes / No",
  "salaryMatch": "N/A or detail",
  "priorityScore": number,
  "recommendation": "Apply / Skip / Review",
  "matchSummary": "1-2 sentence summary of fit",
  "contactEmail": "email address if found in job description, otherwise blank"
}

options.system: You are a recruitment screening engine. Evaluate candidate fit strictly according to the provided rubric and return ONLY valid JSON.

parameters.text: =[Job Automation] Found {{ $input.all().length }} high-match new jobs (>= {{ $('Parse Candidate Profile').first().json.minMatchScore }}%). Starting tailoring...

options.system: You are a career development coach. Create resume bullets and cover letter elements strictly tailored to this company and role.

parameters.text: =[Job Automation] Tailored resume and cover letter generated for {{ $json.job.title }} at {{ $json.job.company }}. Priority Match: {{ $json.tailored.priorityScore }}

parameters.subject: =Tailored Application Package: {{ $json.job.title }} at {{ $json.job.company }}

parameters.text: =[Job Automation] Workflow execution completed. CRM updated and follow-ups scheduled.
